name: policy-store
description: Read-only policy rule engine. Deterministic evaluation of 8 default rules — no LLM involved. Write access via admin tools only.

tools.name: get_active_policies
tools.description: Return all active policy rules for a tenant.

tools.name: is_pii_table
tools.description: Check if a table is registered as PII for the given tenant.

tools.name: get_threshold
tools.description: Return a configurable threshold value by key.

tools.name: get_non_transactional_extensions
tools.description: Return extensions classified as non-transactional (pg_net, dblink, etc.).

tools.name: evaluate_rules
tools.description: Evaluate operation against all active policy rules. Deterministic — no LLM. Returns triggered rules and recommended action.
